collection_date_note: Sources were observed on Nov 18. Earlier edition dates retain their real HF recommendation or other-source windows; this is a delayed publication.

intro.en: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: This delayed collection and review bulletin was reviewed on Nov 18, not completed on Nov 17. A complete 41-paper HF board for Nov 17 was fetched on Nov 18 and reconciled by identity and recommendation date. Three-round scope review excludes all 41 from this topic, so this edition includes no new paper. The Sage S1.5/S2.1 naming conflict and the SPILLWAY version-number conflict remain recorded; scope exclusion does not resolve those source conflicts. The Nov 16 late board now contains 40 papers and is handled under its actual recommendation date. All 12 enabled sources were actually attempted on Nov 18 between 09:17 and 09:22 Asia/Shanghai. The strict source window contained 423 occurrences across 388 stable IDs and added 122 new records (103 papers and 19 posts). Seven historical issue paper candidates were separately verified and ingested, bringing total new records to 129 (110 papers and 19 posts), not 129 inclusions. Three arXiv queries returned zero window entries; the five RSS feeds returned 5, 6, 47, 7 and 0. Release checks succeeded for 13 GitHub repositories with no window releases. S2 citations retained 277 window occurrences across 246 IDs, but 46 requests included 15 rate limits and reached a 180-second cutoff. Author identity lookup succeeded but paper traversal was blocked by six rate limits; unvisited coverage remains unknown.
intro.zh: 采集与审核简报已发布，本期未收录新论文。发布前采集与审核记录：本期是延迟补发的采集与审核简报，实际审核日11/18，不冒称11/17准时完成。11/18复抓11/17完整HF推荐榜41篇，身份、推荐日期和稳定ID均已入库；三轮范围审查41篇均不符合本专题，故本期新增论文0篇。Sage的S1.5/S2.1称谓与SPILLWAY的版本数字冲突逐项保留；范围排除不等于已消除来源冲突。11/16晚到榜单已补齐40篇，并另按11/16推荐日出版。11/18北京时间09:17–09:22实际尝试全部12路启用来源，严格窗口423次出现、388个稳定ID；窗口新增122条（103篇论文、19篇公告），另核实入库7个历史issue论文候选，总计新增129条（110篇论文、19篇公告），不是129篇已纳入论文。三路arXiv检索均成功返回窗口0条；五路RSS分别5、6、47、7、0条；13个GitHub仓库release检查成功、窗口0条。S2 citations保存277次窗口出现、246个ID，但46次请求含15次429且达到180秒截止；authors只有作者身份查询成功、论文遍历被6次429阻断，未访问覆盖仍unknown。
